title: Livelihood strategies and socioeconomic adaptation of resettled households from the Mokattam project in Asmarat district, Cairo, Egypt
core_idea: Analyze how adaptive livelihood strategies and economic shocks affect post-resettlement outcomes of households in Asmarat by applying a sustainable livelihoods framework to interview data from resettled households.
tldr: Study examines the relationship between livelihood adaptation strategies and economic shocks on post-resettlement socioeconomic outcomes in Asmarat using a sustainable livelihoods model and household interviews.
